描述_EN: density 20x38 threads/sq.cm, cross- sectional width of warp 0.1mm, of weft 0.3mm. fragment of silk tapestry (kesi), woven in coloured silks and gold thread on a red ground. the other symbols in the intervals of the cloud scrolls bound with fillets represent the eight emblems of the daoist immortals. in the middle is a vase filled with peaches and flowers, surrounded by scrolled clouds and flying bats carrying swastika symbols in their mouths.
描述_ZN: 密度20x38线/平方厘米，经线截面宽度0.1mm，纬线截面宽度0.3mm。 丝织挂毯碎片，以彩色丝绸和金线在红地上编织而成。 在云卷的间隔中用丝线捆绑的其他符号代表了道教的八个仙人的标志。 中间是一个装满桃子和鲜花的花瓶，周围是卷云和飞翔的蝙蝠，嘴里叼着卐字符号。
